hypothesis: The first causal post-HOT entry is structurally poor, while a fixed 2% pullback materially improves entry quality and retains a positive best-exit ceiling. A simple causal risk/trailing exit may capture enough of that ceiling to become a useful downstream teacher.
entry_rule: first causal state within 10 clock minutes that is at least 2% below the running post-HOT high; otherwise cash
exit_rule: After pullback entry, EXIT at the first observed causal state where return from entry <= hard stop, drawdown from running post-entry high <= -trail, or elapsed time >= max hold; otherwise terminal exit.
forbidden: using May8 or May11-20 to select the exit rule
changing the 2% pullback entry after seeing results
using future-best exit as a deployed rule
next_if_pass: Use the pullback+trailing policy as the downstream teacher for causal learned ENTER/WAIT and HOLD/EXIT.
next_if_fail: Revisit candidate admission and pullback-state admission jointly; the simple exit family does not capture the causal ceiling.
